words.example_en: Because Jane does not listen to her, Jane's mom is angry.
words.example_uz: Jeyn uni tinglamasligi sababli, Jeynning onasi jahldor.

words.example_en: Jason hates staying inside because it is so boring.
words.example_uz: Jason ichkarida qolishdan nafratlanardi chunki bu zerikarli.

words.example_en: Ryan's dad teaches a new class.
words.example_uz: Ryanning dadasi yangi sinfni oʻqitadi.

words.example_en: She dreams about living in the city.
words.example_uz: U shaharda yashashni orzu qiladi.

words.example_en: The kids like the famous baseball player.
words.example_uz: Bolalar mashhur beysbol oʻyinchisini yoqtiradi.

words.example_en: He felt very hot after walking for half the morning.
words.example_uz: U ertalab yarim soat yurganidan soʻng oʻzini juda issiq his qildi.

words.example_en: In the future, we will not need roads for driving.
words.example_uz: Kelajakda bizga haydash uchun yoʻllar kerak boʻlmaydi.

words.example_en: The group uses a large table to study.
words.example_uz: Guruh oʻqish uchun katta stoldan foydalanadi.

words.example_en: Her hobbies are drawing and painting.
words.example_uz: Uning sevimli mashgʻulotlari chizish va boʻyash.

words.example_en: She needs money, so she wants to get a job.
words.example_uz: Unga pul zarur, shuning uchun u ishga kirishni xohlaydi.

words.example_en: Five hundred dollars is a lot of money.
words.example_uz: Besh yuz dollar katta pul.

words.example_en: Mrs. Jones invited us into her home.
words.example_uz: Jones xonim bizni uyiga taklif qildi.

words.example_en: The boy is good at math.
words.example_uz: Bola matematikadan yaxshi.

words.example_en: I am glad you shared these photos with me.
words.example_uz: Men bu rasmlarni men bilan boʻlishganligingizdan xursandman.

words.example_en: Many kids dream about becoming their country's president.
words.example_uz: Koʻpchilik bolalar oʻz davlatining prezidenti boʻlishini xohlaydi.

words.example_en: This TV show is really good.
words.example_uz: Bu TV shou haqiqatdan yaxshi.

words.example_en: The woman answered a lot of questions during her speech.
words.example_uz: Ayol nutqi davomida koʻp savollarga javob berdi.

words.example_en: Vicky loves to travel. She goes to many faraway places.
words.example_uz: Vikki sayohat qilishni yoqtiradi. U koʻp uzoq joylarga boradi.

words.example_en: Janet has a beautiful voice. She should give singing lessons.
words.example_uz: Janettaning chiroyli ovozi bor. U kuylashdan dars berishi kerak.

words.example_en: Carlos did not bring a pencil to class today. I wonder why.
words.example_uz: Karlos bugun sinfga qalamini olib bormadi. Men negaligiga hayronman.
